browser_target.limits: Installed version only, isolated profile, synthetic keyboard/composition/clipboard where used; not recent-two-version, reader or physical-device acceptance.

checks.name: closing detail invalidates previously generated selected-object link
selecting a record invalidates a link generated without selection
query change rejects late clipboard failure and removes old link
close and reopen rejects late clipboard success
older failed copy cannot replace newer successful copy status
generated share field meets touch size and fits dialog
current clipboard denial retains a selectable manual link
manual fallback selects the complete link
filter change removes both old manual link and old status
next link reflects current filter and snapshot

scope: Real current list state and native touch events in 390px emulation with controlled clipboard promises. No OS clipboard, physical device or reader proof.
